Find, enrich and push sales prospects into HubSpot
A commenter uses Claude connected to Clay and HubSpot to find organizations and contacts, enrich records, and push them into HubSpot.
·
Nov 21, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The commenter says they connected Claude with Clay and HubSpot and used that setup to find organizations and points of contact, enrich those records, and then push them into HubSpot. The source does not add more detail on the workflow steps, inputs, or any manual review beyond that brief description.
How it went
It appears useful for prospecting and CRM data entry, but the commenter gives no numbers or concrete results. The only downside they mention is spending more time second-guessing whether emails sound human or AI-written.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Find [number] organizations matching this profile: [industry, size, region, other criteria], and the best contacts at each with the title [target job titles]. Enrich each record with [fields such as email, website, headcount, LinkedIn] using Clay. Before adding anything to HubSpot, show me the full list in a table and wait for my approval. You are done when the approved records are in HubSpot with no duplicates of existing contacts.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/techsales/comments/1y1kll5/alright_obligatory_ai_thread_how_are_you_guys
